official.mc: 55 questions, 5 sets, 8-13 each, >=2 prose/drama and >=2 poetry sets; weights short fiction 42-49%, poetry 36-45%, longer fiction/drama 15-18%; 20th/21st-century texts outnumber earlier ones
official.frq: Q1 poetry analysis (~100-400 words), Q2 prose fiction analysis (~600-800 words, drama possible), Q3 literary argument (student chooses a work)
